name: phd-leave-current-semester-after-import
description: Policy review round 3, P3-dh-3.1-3.13-2 (DGS 2026-10-06: “Apply the handling with option (b)”). A Ph.D. student who entered Fall 2023, registered every fall and spring through Spring 2026 (imported Notre Dame transcript), is on approved medical leave in Fall 2026. The leave question used to appear only for an empty semester between two registered ones, so this leave could not be entered and the admission deadline read "Spring 2027 — semester 8", due next semester. Your standing now names the empty current semester (src/ui/withdrawals.ts transcriptGapSemesters; tests/transcript-gaps.test.ts); with the leave entered the eighth semester is Fall 2027, semester 9, and the time limit moves to during Spring 2032 (Academic Code §6.2.6).

detailIncludes: Semester 8 is counted as semester 9 — extended by 1 semester on approved medical leave before it
